resources.string: Settings backup
Export or import local settings and widget presets (not messages)

Includes global accent color, light/dark/system/OLED mode, text size, system font and automatic colors; global notification behavior, swipe actions, sending options and signature; voice/reader engines, languages, wake word, reply/retry/announcement options, Kokoro voice/speed and car connection behavior; and the map tile-cache preference.\n\nIncludes all stock watchlists and groups, group decoration, compact/dense/cards layouts, charts, columns, ticker text size, currency visibility, transparency, manual/follow-app-theme colors, refresh intervals and the remembered watchlist. Includes every world clock’s city, time zone and text color, plus previously imported presets.

Not included: messages, contacts, per-conversation overrides, blocked senders, logs, quotes, weather or map caches; cookies, authentication, sessions, nonces, API keys; permissions, pending actions, microphone/location running states, background-work state or control-widget on/off state. Also excluded: automatic message deletion, diagnostic logging, legacy night schedules, custom ringtone files/URIs, speech model files/paths and web-AI settings. Re-select local speech models on a new phone.\n\nThis is a readable, unencrypted settings file and may contain personal watchlists, city labels and your signature. Choose device-local storage in the file picker. SilentPulse does not upload it or automatically back it up.

Widget IDs belong to your launcher, not the backup. Imported stock and clock configurations are retained as portable presets; existing widgets are not overwritten by numeric ID. Add or configure a widget, then choose “Imported presets” from its menu and save. Stock “Verify and save” explicitly contacts Yahoo; importing this file does not. Launcher placement and size cannot be restored here. Each widget remains independent.
